<script>
/**
 * SETTINGS — CLIENT-SIDE JS (Sprint 5, item 1)
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  function canUseServer() {
    return typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run;
  }

  function setText(id, value) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.textContent = value;
  }

  function initials(name, email) {
    var source = name || email || 'ST';
    var parts = String(source).replace(/@.*$/, '').split(/[\s._-]+/).filter(Boolean);
    var a = (parts[0] && parts[0][0]) || 'S';
    var b = (parts[1] && parts[1][0]) || (parts[0] && parts[0][1]) || 'T';
    return (a + b).toUpperCase();
  }

  function load(email) {
    setText('settings-email', email);
    var av = document.getElementById('settings-avatar');
    if (av) av.textContent = initials(null, email);

    if (!canUseServer()) return;

    if (window.BioEthics && window.BioEthics.showViewLoading) {
      window.BioEthics.showViewLoading('view-settings', 'Loading your settings…');
    }
    var errEl = document.getElementById('settings-load-error');
    if (errEl) errEl.hidden = true;
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function (data) {
        if (window.BioEthics && window.BioEthics.hideViewLoading) window.BioEthics.hideViewLoading('view-settings');
        setText('settings-name', data.studentName || '\u2014');
        setText('settings-email', data.email || email);
        setText('settings-semester', data.semester || '\u2014');
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function () {
        if (window.BioEthics && window.BioEthics.hideViewLoading) window.BioEthics.hideViewLoading('view-settings');
        if (errEl) errEl.hidden = false;
      })
      .getMyDashboardData(email);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var toggle = document.getElementById('settings-sidebar-toggle');
    if (toggle) toggle.addEventListener('click', function () { document.body.classList.toggle('sidebar-open'); });

    var crumbDash = document.querySelector('.crumb-dashboard-link');
    if (crumbDash) {
      crumbDash.addEventListener('click', function (evt) {
        evt.preventDefault();
        if (window.BioEthics && window.BioEthics.goToView) {
          window.BioEthics.goToView('dashboard');
          window.BioEthics.refreshDashboard && window.BioEthics.refreshDashboard();
        }
      });
    }
  });

  window.BioEthicsSettings = { load: load };
})();
</script>

<style>
/* ==================================================================
   BIOETHICS PORTAL — DESIGN SYSTEM
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Token summary (kept here in comments so future sprints don't
   redefine colors ad hoc):

     Deep Blue     #0F4C81   primary brand / nav / links
     Emerald       #2E8B57   success / approved / secondary actions
     Amber         #C98A2C   "needs revision" / pending states
     Rose          #C0392B   rejected / destructive states
     Ink           #16202B   headline text
     Slate         #5B6472   body / secondary text
     Cloud         #F5F7FA   app background
     Line          #E3E8EF   borders/dividers
     White         #FFFFFF   card surfaces

   Type: Poppins (headings, 500-700) / Inter (everything else)

   SIGNATURE ELEMENT: the "strand" — a two-line ladder motif
   (nods to a DNA strand without being literal clip-art) used as
   the hero divider, section-header underline, and — functionally —
   restyled as the application-status stepper on the dashboard,
   where each "rung" is a real stage of the review pipeline.
   ================================================================== */

:root{
  --blue: #0F4C81;
  --blue-dark: #0B3A63;
  --blue-tint: #EAF2FA;
  --green: #2E8B57;
  --green-dark: #226B43;
  --green-tint: #E8F5EC;
  --amber: #C98A2C;
  --amber-tint: #FBF1E1;
  --orange: #C1560E;
  --orange-tint: #FBEADF;
  --rose: #C0392B;
  --rose-tint: #FBEAE8;
  --ink: #16202B;
  --slate: #5B6472;
  --slate-light: #8993A1;
  --cloud: #F5F7FA;
  --line: #E3E8EF;
  --white: #FFFFFF;

  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 14px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;

  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,30,54,.05), 0 1px 3px rgba(16,30,54,.06);
  --shadow-md: 0 6px 16px rgba(16,30,54,.08);
  --shadow-lg: 0 18px 40px rgba(16,30,54,.12);

  --font-head: 'Poppins', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
}

*,*::before,*::after{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; }
body{
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--cloud);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{ font-family: var(--font-head); margin:0; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
p{ margin:0; }
a{ color: inherit; text-decoration:none; }
button{ font-family: var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; }
ul{ margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; }
::selection{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue-dark); }

/* Focus visibility (kept even though sprint has no real auth flow yet) */
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible{
  outline: 2.5px solid var(--blue);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.icon{ width:18px; height:18px; display:inline-block; vertical-align:-3px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   VIEW SWITCHING (client-side "router")
   <body data-view="landing|login|dashboard|wizard|annex"> controls visibility.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.view{ display:none; position:relative; }
body[data-view="coordinator"] #view-coordinator{ display:grid; }
/* Sprint 5 — #26 Loading States. Generic overlay + spinner, reusable across
   any .view container via showViewLoading(viewId) / hideViewLoading(viewId)
   in 09_Shared_JavaScript.html. Kept deliberately simple (one spinner design)
   so every page that adopts it looks consistent. */
.loading-overlay{
  position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:40;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
}
.loading-overlay .spinner{
  width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%;
  border:3px solid var(--line); border-top-color: var(--blue);
  animation: be-spin .7s linear infinite;
}
.loading-overlay .loading-label{
  font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--slate);
}
@keyframes be-spin{ to{ transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* Small inline variant for buttons/panels mid-save (not a full overlay) */
.spinner-inline{
  display:inline-block; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-top-color:#fff;
  animation: be-spin .6s linear infinite; vertical-align:-2px; margin-right:6px;
}

/* Sprint 5, #34 — inactivity warning modal, sits above everything regardless
   of which view is currently active (that's why it's outside the .view grid,
   fixed to the viewport, and given a z-index above the loading overlay). */
.inactivity-modal-overlay{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:200;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background: rgba(22,32,43,.45); padding:20px;
}
.inactivity-modal{
  background:#fff; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  padding:24px 26px; max-width:380px; text-align:center;
}
.inactivity-modal h3{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font-size:16px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.inactivity-modal p{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--slate); line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:16px; }
.inactivity-modal .btn{ width:100%; }
body[data-view="landing"] #view-landing{ display:block; }
body[data-view="login"] #view-login{ display:flex; }
body[data-view="dashboard"] #view-dashboard{ display:grid; }
body[data-view="wizard"] #view-wizard{ display:grid; }
body[data-view="reviewer"] #view-reviewer{ display:grid; }
body[data-view="annex"] #view-annex{ display:grid; }
body[data-view="applications"] #view-applications{ display:block; }
body[data-view="settings"] #view-settings{ display:block; }
body[data-view="committee"] #view-committee{ display:block; }

/* ==================================================================
   SIGNATURE MOTIF — "the strand"
   Two offset horizontal lines with connecting rungs, drawn with a
   single repeating-linear-gradient background. Used as a divider.
   ================================================================== */
.strand{
  --strand-color: var(--blue);
  height: 14px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 220px;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--strand-color), var(--strand-color)),
    linear-gradient(var(--strand-color), var(--strand-color)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--strand-color) 0 2px, transparent 2px 18px);
  background-size: 100% 2px, 100% 2px, 100% 8px;
  background-position: top left, bottom left, center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat, repeat-x;
  opacity: .55;
}

/* ==================================================================
   BUTTONS
   ================================================================== */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:600; padding:12px 22px;
  border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn:active{ transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn-primary{ background: var(--blue); color:#fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.btn-primary:hover{ background: var(--blue-dark); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.btn-secondary{ background: var(--green); color:#fff; }
.btn-secondary:hover{ background: var(--green-dark); }
.btn-ghost{ background: transparent; color: var(--blue); border-color: var(--line); }
.btn-ghost:hover{ background: var(--blue-tint); border-color: var(--blue-tint); }
.btn-outline{ background:#fff; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--line); }
.btn-outline:hover{ border-color: var(--slate-light); }
.btn-block{ width:100%; }
.btn-lg{ padding:15px 30px; font-size:16px; }
.btn[disabled]{ opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

/* ==================================================================
   LANDING PAGE
   ================================================================== */
#view-landing{ min-height:100vh; }

.topbar{
  position: sticky; top:0; z-index:20;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding: 16px 6vw;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.brand-mark{
  width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:11px;
  background: linear-gradient(155deg, var(--blue), var(--green));
  color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.brand-text{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.15; }
.brand-title{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight:700; font-size:16px; color: var(--ink); }
.brand-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color: var(--slate); font-weight:500; }

.nav-links{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px; }
.nav-links a{ font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color: var(--slate); transition: color .15s; }
.nav-links a:hover{ color: var(--blue); }
.nav-actions{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.nav-toggle{ display:none; background:none; border:none; color:var(--ink); padding:6px; }

.hero{
  padding: 88px 6vw 70px;
  display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap:56px; align-items:center;
  max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto;
}
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-tint);
  padding:7px 14px; border-radius:999px; margin-bottom:22px;
}
.hero h1{
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 52px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.08;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero h1 .accent{ color: var(--blue); }
.hero-desc{ font-size:17px; color: var(--slate); max-width:520px; margin-bottom:18px; }
.hero .strand{ margin: 26px 0 30px; }
.hero-ctas{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:8px; }
.hero-meta{ display:flex; gap:28px; margin-top:38px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.hero-meta div{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.hero-meta strong{ font-family:var(--font-head); font-size:22px; color:var(--ink); }
.hero-meta span{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--slate); }

.hero-visual{
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue) 0%, var(--blue-dark) 60%, var(--green-dark) 130%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  min-height: 400px;
  padding: 30px;
  position: relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end;
}
.hero-visual::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute; inset:0;
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 2px, transparent 2px 26px);
}
.hero-visual-card{
  position:relative; background: rgba(255,255,255,.97); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding:20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.hero-visual-card .row{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px; }
.hero-visual-card .row:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }
.pipeline-mini{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; margin-top:14px; }
.pipeline-mini .dot{ width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--line); }
.pipeline-mini .dot.done{ background: var(--green); }
.pipeline-mini .dot.current{ background: var(--blue); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--blue-tint); }
.pipeline-mini .bar{ flex:1; height:2px; background: var(--line); }
.pipeline-mini .bar.done{ background: var(--green); }

.section{ padding: 60px 6vw; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; }
.section-head{ margin-bottom:32px; max-width:640px; }
.section-head .eyebrow{ margin-bottom:14px; }
.section-head h2{ font-size:28px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.section-head p{ color: var(--slate); font-size:15.5px; }

.card-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap:20px; }
.role-card{
  background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding:26px 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;
}
.role-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: transparent; }
.role-card .role-icon{
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue);
}
.role-card:nth-child(2) .role-icon{ background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green); }
.role-card:nth-child(3) .role-icon{ background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber); }
.role-card:nth-child(4) .role-icon{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue-dark); }
.role-card h3{ font-size:16.5px; }
.role-card p{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--slate); flex:1; }
.role-card .role-link{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color: var(--blue); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; }

.announce-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap:24px; }
.panel{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.panel-header{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:20px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.panel-header h3{ font-size:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; }
.panel-header h3 svg{ color: var(--blue); }
.announce-list{ padding: 8px 24px 20px; }
.announce-item{ display:flex; gap:14px; padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.announce-item:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.announce-tag{
  flex-shrink:0; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:5px 9px; border-radius:6px; height:fit-content; margin-top:2px;
}
.announce-tag.deadline{ background: var(--rose-tint); color: var(--rose); }
.announce-tag.meeting{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue); }
.announce-tag.notice{ background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber); }
.announce-body strong{ display:block; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:3px; }
.announce-body span{ font-size:13px; color: var(--slate); }

.faq-panel .announce-list{ padding: 6px 24px 22px; }
.faq-item{ padding:15px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.faq-item:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.faq-item summary{ cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; list-style:none; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display:none; }
.faq-item summary svg{ color: var(--slate-light); transition: transform .15s; flex-shrink:0; }
.faq-item[open] summary svg{ transform: rotate(90deg); }
.faq-item p{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--slate); margin-top:9px; }

.cta-strip{
  margin: 20px 6vw 0; max-width:1280px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--blue), var(--blue-dark));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding:44px 48px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:30px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  color:#fff;
}
.cta-strip h2{ color:#fff; font-size:24px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.cta-strip p{ color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size:14.5px; }
.cta-strip .btn-outline{ background:#fff; border-color:#fff; }

.site-footer{ padding: 46px 6vw 30px; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; }
.footer-top{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:24px; padding-bottom:26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); flex-wrap:wrap; }
.footer-cols{ display:flex; gap:60px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.footer-col h4{ font-size:12.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color: var(--slate-light); margin-bottom:12px; }
.footer-col a{ display:block; font-size:14px; color: var(--slate); margin-bottom:9px; }
.footer-col a:hover{ color: var(--blue); }
.footer-bottom{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-top:20px; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--slate-light); flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; }
.version-badge{ background: var(--cloud); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-weight:600; }

/* ==================================================================
   LOGIN PAGE
   ================================================================== */
#view-login{
  min-height:100vh; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(15,76,129,.07), transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(46,139,87,.07), transparent 40%),
    var(--cloud);
  padding: 40px 20px;
}
.login-shell{ width:100%; max-width:960px; display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow:hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.login-aside{
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue), var(--blue-dark) 55%, var(--green-dark) 140%);
  color:#fff; padding:46px 38px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.login-aside::before{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 2px, transparent 2px 26px); }
.login-aside > *{ position:relative; }
.login-aside .brand-mark{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
.login-aside h2{ color:#fff; font-size:23px; margin: 22px 0 12px; line-height:1.25; }
.login-aside p{ color: rgba(255,255,255,.78); font-size:14px; }
.login-aside-list{ margin-top:26px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; }
.login-aside-list li{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.92); }

.login-main{ background:#fff; padding: 48px 42px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; }
.login-main h1{ font-size:24px; margin-bottom:6px; }
.login-main .sub{ color: var(--slate); font-size:14px; margin-bottom:30px; }
.field{ margin-bottom:18px; }
.field label{ display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom:7px; }
.input-wrap{ position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.input-wrap svg{ position:absolute; left:14px; color: var(--slate-light); }
.field input{
  width:100%; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size:14.5px;
  padding:12.5px 14px 12.5px 42px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--cloud);
  transition: border-color .15s, background .15s;
}
.field input:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--blue); background:#fff; }
.field-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin: 4px 0 22px; }
.remember{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:13px; color: var(--slate); }
.link-btn{ background:none; border:none; padding:0; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--blue); }
.link-btn:hover{ text-decoration: underline; }
.role-pills{ display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.role-pill{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:#fff; color: var(--slate); transition: all .15s; }
.role-pill.active{ background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); color:#fff; }
.login-back{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:13.5px; color: var(--slate); margin-top:26px; }
.login-back:hover{ color: var(--blue); }
.login-note{
  margin-top:22px; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-tint);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding:10px 13px; display:flex; gap:9px; align-items:flex-start;
}
.login-note svg{ flex-shrink:0; margin-top:1px; }

/* ==================================================================
   STUDENT DASHBOARD (app shell: sidebar + topbar + content)
   ================================================================== */
#view-dashboard{
  grid-template-columns: 256px 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 68px 1fr;
  grid-template-areas: "sidebar topbar" "sidebar main";
  min-height:100vh;
}
.sidebar{
  grid-area: sidebar; background: var(--blue-dark); color:#fff;
  padding: 22px 16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:26px;
  position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh;
}
.sidebar .brand{ padding: 0 8px; }
.sidebar .brand-mark{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
.sidebar .brand-title, .sidebar .brand-sub{ color:#fff; }
.sidebar .brand-sub{ color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); }
.side-nav{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; flex:1; }
.side-link{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 14px; border-radius:10px;
  font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.side-link svg{ flex-shrink:0; }
.side-link:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); color:#fff; }
.side-link.active{ background: #fff; color: var(--blue-dark); font-weight:600; }
.side-foot{ border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); padding-top:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; }

.topbar-app{
  grid-area: topbar; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 28px;
}
.topbar-title{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.topbar-title strong{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-size:15px; }
.topbar-title span{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); }

/* Sprint 5, #25 — breadcrumb trail. Reuses the existing subtitle slot
   (same size/color already established) rather than adding a new row,
   to avoid touching the fixed-height topbar grid used across every page. */
.breadcrumb{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate-light); }
.breadcrumb a{ color: var(--slate); text-decoration:none; }
.breadcrumb a:hover{ color: var(--blue); text-decoration:underline; }
.breadcrumb .crumb-sep{ margin:0 5px; color: var(--slate-light); }
.breadcrumb .crumb-current{ color: var(--slate); font-weight:600; }
.topbar-right{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; }
.icon-btn{
  position:relative; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color: var(--slate);
}
.icon-btn:hover{ background: var(--cloud); }
.icon-btn .dot{ position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--rose); border:1.5px solid #fff; }

/* Sprint 5, #24 — Danger button category. Applied to destructive icon
   buttons (remove hazard row, remove uploaded file) that previously had
   no visual warning before an irreversible delete. */
.icon-btn-danger{ color: var(--rose); }
.icon-btn-danger:hover{ background: var(--rose-tint); color: var(--rose); }
.avatar{ width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:10px; background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green-dark); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; }
.topbar-user{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.topbar-user-info{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.2; }
.topbar-user-info strong{ font-size:13.5px; }
.topbar-user-info span{ font-size:11.5px; color: var(--slate); }

.main-app{ grid-area: main; padding: 26px 28px 50px; max-width:1180px; }
.page-heading{ margin-bottom:22px; }
.page-heading h1{ font-size:23px; margin-bottom:5px; }
.page-heading p{ color: var(--slate); font-size:14px; }

.stat-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap:16px; margin-bottom:22px; }
.stat-card{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:18px 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.stat-card-clickable{ cursor:pointer; transition: box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; }
.stat-card-clickable:hover{ box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: var(--blue); }
.stat-card-clickable:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset:2px; }
.stat-card .stat-top{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:14px; }
.stat-icon{ width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:9px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue); }
.stat-card:nth-child(2) .stat-icon{ background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green); }
.stat-card:nth-child(3) .stat-icon{ background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber); }
.stat-card:nth-child(4) .stat-icon{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue-dark); }
.stat-label{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); font-weight:500; margin-bottom:4px; }
.stat-value{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-size:19px; font-weight:600; }
.status-badge{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; }
/* Sprint 5 — #32 status color audit: each application status now has its own
   color, matching the agreed scheme (Draft=Gray, Submitted=Blue,
   Under Review=Orange, Revision Requested=Yellow/Amber, Approved=Green,
   Rejected=Red). Previously Draft/Revision Requested were both amber and
   Submitted/Under Review were both blue — indistinguishable at a glance. */
.status-badge.draft{ background: var(--cloud); color: var(--slate); }
.status-badge.submitted{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue); }
.status-badge.approved{ background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green-dark); }

.status-badge.inprogress{ background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber); }
.status-badge.completed{ background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green-dark); }
.status-badge.assigned{ background: var(--cloud); color: var(--slate); }

.app-card{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:22px; }
.app-card-head{ padding:22px 26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; }

.app-card-head h3 svg{ color: var(--blue); }

.app-id{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color: var(--blue); }
.app-meta-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap:20px; margin-bottom:26px; }
.app-meta-grid .meta-label{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); margin-bottom:5px; }
.app-meta-grid .meta-value{ font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600; }

/* Stepper — the dashboard's functional application of the "strand" motif:

.step:last-child .connector{ display:none; }
.step.done .node{ background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); color:#fff; }

.step.current .node{ background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); color:#fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--blue-tint); }
.step .step-label{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; color: var(--slate-light); max-width:88px; }

.progress-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin: 24px 0; }
.progress-track{ flex:1; height:10px; background: var(--cloud); border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.progress-fill{ height:100%; border-radius:999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue), var(--green)); }
.progress-pct{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight:600; font-size:14px; width:44px; text-align:right; }

.next-action{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background: var(--blue-tint); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:16px 20px; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.next-action-left{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.next-action-left .icon-circle{ width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; color: var(--blue); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
.next-action-left strong{ display:block; font-size:14px; }
.next-action-left span{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--slate); }
.app-card-actions{ display:flex; gap:12px; padding: 4px 26px 26px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

.two-col{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; gap:20px; }
.mini-panel{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.mini-panel-head{ padding:18px 22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.mini-panel-head svg{ color: var(--blue); }
.notif-list{ padding:8px 22px 18px; }
.notif-item{ display:flex; gap:12px; padding:13px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.notif-item:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.notif-dot{ width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--blue); margin-top:6px; flex-shrink:0; }
.notif-item.read .notif-dot{ background: var(--line); }
.notif-item strong{ display:block; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; }
.notif-item span{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); }

.help-box{ padding:20px 22px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; }
.help-box p{ font-size:13px; color: var(--slate); }

/* ==================================================================

   ================================================================== */

.wiz-main{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:18px; padding-bottom:110px; }

.wiz-toast{

.wiz-panel-head{ margin-bottom: 8px; }

.wiz-card{

}

.field-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px 20px;
}
.field-span-2{ grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.req{ color: var(--rose); }
.opt{ color: var(--slate-light); font-weight:500; font-size:12px; }

.plain-input, .plain-textarea, select.plain-input{

}

}

.plain-input.is-invalid, .plain-textarea.is-invalid{ border-color: var(--rose); background: var(--rose-tint); }
.field-error{ min-height: 16px; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--rose); margin-top:6px; }
.field-hint{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--slate); margin-top:12px; }

.desc-cards{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }
.desc-card{
  background:#fff; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 20px 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.desc-card.is-met{ border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--green-tint); }
.desc-card-head{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:12px; }

.desc-card-head p{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--slate); margin-top:2px; }
.word-meter{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.word-count{

}

.wiz-split{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr .9fr; gap:16px; align-items:start; }

}

.annex-summary h3{ font-size:15px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.annex-summary h3 svg{ color: var(--blue); }
.annex-list{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; margin-top:14px; }
.annex-list li{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color: var(--green-dark);

}
.annex-list li svg{ color: var(--green); }
.annex-empty{ background: var(--cloud) !important; color: var(--slate) !important; font-weight:500 !important; }

.risk-card{ overflow:hidden; }

}

.risk-extra-box{

}
.risk-extra-box label{ display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; }

.preview-root{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; }

  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); overflow:hidden;
}
.preview-card-head{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px;
  padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background: var(--cloud);
}

.btn-sm{ padding: 8px 14px; font-size:13px; }
.preview-body{ padding: 18px 20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.preview-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.preview-row span{ font-size:13px; color: var(--slate); }
.preview-row strong{ font-size:13.5px; text-align:right; max-width: 65%; font-weight:600; }
.preview-body h4{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--blue); margin-top:6px; }
.preview-prose{ font-size:14px; color: var(--ink); white-space: pre-wrap; line-height:1.55; }
.preview-hazard{ padding: 12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }

.declaration-card{ margin-top:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }

}

.annex-dash-card-head span{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); }

.rev-toolbar input[type="search"]{
  width:100%; padding:10px 12px 10px 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:#fff; font-size:13.5px; font-family: var(--font-body);
}
.rev-toolbar input[type="search"]:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--blue); }
.rev-filter-pills{ display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
#view-coordinator{
  min-height:100vh;
  grid-template-columns: 256px 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: 68px 1fr;
  grid-template-areas: "sidebar topbar" "sidebar main";
}
#view-coordinator .main-app{ padding-bottom:110px; }
/* Assigned-applications table */
.rev-table-wrap{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); overflow:hidden; }
.rev-table{ width:100%; border-collapse:separate; border-spacing:0; }
.rev-table th{
  text-align:left; font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em;
  color: var(--slate); padding:14px 16px; font-weight:600; background: var(--cloud); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.rev-table td{ padding:14px 16px; font-size:13.5px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:middle; }
.rev-table tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:none; }
.rev-table tr:hover td{ background: var(--blue-tint); }

/* Sprint 5 — #30 sortable table headers (My Applications, and reusable
   for any other .rev-table that opts in via the apps-sort-th class). */
.apps-sort-th{ cursor:pointer; user-select:none; white-space:nowrap; }
.apps-sort-th:hover{ color: var(--ink); }
.apps-sort-arrow{ display:inline-block; width:10px; opacity:.5; }
.apps-sort-th.is-active .apps-sort-arrow{ opacity:1; }
.rev-table .rev-title{ font-weight:600; color: var(--ink); }
.rev-table .rev-sub{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); }
.rev-empty{ padding: 40px 20px; text-align:center; color: var(--slate); font-size:14px; }

/* Review detail: sticky section nav + comment/rubric panels */
.rev-detail-head{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:18px; }
.rev-detail-head h1{ font-size:21px; margin-bottom:4px; }
.rev-detail-head p{ color: var(--slate); font-size:13.5px; }
.rev-detail-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; gap:20px; align-items:start; }
.rev-section-nav{ position:sticky; top:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:8px; }
.rev-section-nav button{
  text-align:left; padding:10px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border:none; background:transparent;
  font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color: var(--slate); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px;
}
.rev-section-nav button:hover{ background: var(--cloud); }
.rev-section-nav button.active{ background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue-dark); font-weight:700; }
.rev-section-nav .sec-dot{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--line); flex-shrink:0; }

.rev-section{ display:none; }
.rev-section.active{ display:block; animation: wizIn .2s ease; }

.rev-readonly-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:12px 20px; margin-bottom:18px; }
.rev-readonly-item{ padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.rev-readonly-item.full{ grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.rev-readonly-item span{ display:block; font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; color: var(--slate); margin-bottom:4px; }
.rev-readonly-item strong{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color: var(--ink); }
.rev-readonly-item p{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--ink); white-space:pre-wrap; line-height:1.55; }

.rev-flag-chips{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin: 4px 0 4px; }
.rev-flag-chip{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background: var(--amber-tint); color: var(--amber); }
.rev-conditional{ background: var(--cloud); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding:10px 12px; margin-top:8px; font-size:13px; }
.rev-conditional dt{ font-weight:600; color: var(--slate); font-size:12px; margin-top:6px; }
.rev-conditional dt:first-child{ margin-top:0; }
.rev-conditional dd{ margin:2px 0 0; color: var(--ink); }

.rev-comment-box{ margin-top:16px; }
.rev-comment-box label{ display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.rev-comment-box label svg{ color: var(--blue); }
.rev-comment-box textarea{
  width:100%; min-height:100px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5;
  padding:12px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border:1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--cloud); resize:vertical;
}
.rev-comment-box textarea:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--blue); background:#fff; }

/* Rubric */
.rubric-grid{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; }
.rubric-criterion{ background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:16px 18px; }
.rubric-criterion-head{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.rubric-criterion-head h4{ font-size:14px; margin-bottom:3px; }
.rubric-criterion-head p{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--slate); }
.rubric-weight{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color: var(--slate); background: var(--cloud); padding:4px 9px; border-radius:999px; flex-shrink:0; }
.rubric-scale{ display:flex; gap:8px; }
.rubric-score-btn{
  flex:1; padding:10px 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border:1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--cloud);
  font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; color: var(--slate); transition: all .12s;
}
.rubric-score-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--blue); }
.rubric-score-btn.selected{ background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); color:#fff; }
.rubric-summary{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background: var(--blue-dark); color:#fff;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:18px 22px; margin-top:6px;
}
.rubric-summary strong{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-size:26px; }
.rubric-summary span{ font-size:12.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }

/* Decision + signature */
.decision-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap:10px; margin-bottom:18px; }
.decision-card{
  border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background:#fff; padding:14px 12px;
  text-align:center; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--slate); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px;
}
.decision-card svg{ width:20px; height:20px; }
.decision-card:hover{ border-color: var(--blue); }
.decision-card.selected[data-decision="Approved"]{ background: var(--green-tint); border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green-dark); }
.decision-card.selected[data-decision="Minor Revisions"],
.decision-card.selected[data-decision="Major Revisions"]{ background: var(--amber-tint); border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--amber); }
.decision-card.selected[data-decision="Rejected"]{ background: var(--rose-tint); border-color: var(--rose); color: var(--rose); }

.signature-box{ background: var(--cloud); border:1px dashed var(--slate-light); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:18px 20px; }
.signature-box input{
  width:100%; border:none; background:transparent; font-family: var(--font-head); font-size:20px; padding:6px 4px;
  border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink);
}
.signature-box input:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--blue); }
.signature-hint{ font-size:12px; color: var(--slate); margin-top:8px; }
.certify-row{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; margin-top:14px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; }
.certify-row input{ width:17px; height:17px; margin-top:2px; accent-color: var(--green); flex-shrink:0; }

.rev-locked-banner{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background: var(--green-tint); color: var(--green-dark); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding:13px 16px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:18px; }

/* Score pill used in tables/history */
.score-pill{ font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; background: var(--blue-tint); color: var(--blue-dark); }

/* ==================================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 980px){
  .hero{ grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:40px; }
  .card-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
  .announce-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .login-shell{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .login-aside{ display:none; }
  #view-dashboard, #view-wizard, #view-annex, #view-reviewer, view-coordinator{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "topbar" "main"; }
  .rev-detail-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .rev-section-nav{ position:static; flex-direction:row; overflow-x:auto; }
  .rev-readonly-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .decision-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .sidebar{ position:fixed; left:0; top:0; z-index:40; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform .2s; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
  body.sidebar-open .sidebar{ transform: translateX(0); }
  .nav-toggle{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .stat-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
  .app-meta-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
  .two-col{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .field-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .wiz-split{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .check-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .wiz-footer, #view-annex .wiz-footer{ left:0; }
  .annex-card-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px){
  .nav-links{ display:none; }
  .card-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stat-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .app-meta-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cta-strip{ flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; }
  .footer-top{ flex-direction:column; }
  .main-app{ padding: 20px 16px 40px; }
  .topbar-app{ padding: 0 16px; }
  .wiz-save-meta span{ max-width: 140px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
}

/* Reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *{ transition-duration: .001ms !important; animation-duration: .001ms !important; }
}

/* ==================================================================
   SPRINT 5, #37 — PRINT LAYOUT
   "Besides PDF download, create a clean print layout" — real PDF
   generation is Sprint 6 scope (see MyApplicationsScript.html), so
   this uses the browser's native print dialog, which offers "Save as
   PDF" as a destination — genuinely gets the person a PDF today.
   Scoped to the Wizard's Preview step, since that's the one place in
   the app that already assembles a complete, clean application view.
   ================================================================== */
@media print {
  /* Hide navigation, menus, and buttons everywhere */
  .sidebar, .topbar-app, .wiz-footer, .nav-toggle, .icon-btn,
  .loading-overlay, .inactivity-modal-overlay, .wiz-toast,
  #wiz-print-btn, .preview-edit, .rev-table-pagination, .rev-table-toolbar {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* Print only the application document itself */
  body[data-view="wizard"] #view-wizard { display: block !important; }
  body[data-view="wizard"] .wiz-panel { display: none !important; }
  body[data-view="wizard"] .wiz-panel[data-step-panel="6"] { display: block !important; }
  body[data-view="wizard"] .main-app { padding: 0; }
  .preview-card { box-shadow: none !important; border: 1px solid #ccc; break-inside: avoid; }
}

/**
 * CORE — Review & Annex reference data
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------
 * These four constants are referenced throughout the server code
 * (00_Core_Validation.gs, 01_Application_Service.gs,
 * 03_Reviewer_Service.gs) but were never actually defined anywhere
 * in the project — a gap since the very first Sprint 3/4 build, not
 * something introduced later. Their absence is what caused:
 *   - "REVIEW_RUBRIC is not defined" when a reviewer opens a review
 *   - annex titles/checklists silently failing on the student's
 *     Annex Dashboard (getAnnexDashboard / buildAnnexCards_)
 *
 * REVIEW_RUBRIC   — scoring criteria shown in the Reviewer Portal's
 *                   "Interactive Rubric" panel. Weights must sum to 100
 *                   (computeOverallScore_ in 00_Core_Validation.gs
 *                   normalizes against total weight either way, but
 *                   100 keeps the displayed weights meaningful as %).
 * REVIEW_SECTIONS — the four commentable sections in the Reviewer
 *                   Portal's review detail screen. IDs must match the
 *                   `data-section` / `#rev-comment-<id>` values already
 *                   hard-coded in 03_Reviewer_Reviewer.html.
 * ANNEX_TITLES      — display title per annex ID, keyed by the same
 *                     "Annex II".."Annex XII" strings produced by
 *                     computeRequiredAnnexes_() in 00_Core_Validation.gs.
 * ANNEX_CHECKLISTS  — checklist item labels per annex ID, used by both
 *                     the student Annex Dashboard and the reviewer's
 *                     read-only annex view.
 * -----------------------------------------------------------------
 */

var REVIEW_RUBRIC = [
  {
    id: 'receipt',
    label: 'Receipt',
    description: 'Application correctly received and administratively complete.',
    maxPoints: 1
  },
  {
    id: 'projectDetails',
    label: 'Section Two: Details of the Project',
    description: 'Brief background, aim/hypothesis, and methods in brief.',
    maxPoints: 1.5
  },

  },
  {

    description: 'Completeness of required annexes.',
    maxPoints: 1
  }
];

  { id: 'annexes', title: 'Required Annexes' }
];
